type.description: Send the asset itself, from any wallet.

deposit_id.description: The deposit this allocation belongs to.

display_inbound_amount.description: The inbound_amount as a decimal string, for display only.

display_outbound_amount.description: The outbound_amount as a decimal string, for display only.

estimated_settlement_minutes.description: How long settlement usually takes after the send.

expires_at.description: Send before this, or allocate again.

inbound_amount.description: The exact amount of the source asset to send, in its smallest unit.

memo.description: Currently always null, reserved for future asset support.

min_source_confirmations.description: The number of confirmations required on the source chain.

outbound_amount.description: What will be credited, in the Balance asset's smallest unit.

source_address.description: Where the user sends the source asset.

source_chain.description: CAIP-2 id of the chain the user sends on.

type.description: Send a different asset, which Final swaps into the asset of the Balance.

amount.description: In the currency's smallest unit: cents for USD.

display_amount.description: The amount as a decimal string, for display only.

descriptor.description: The merchant's name as the issuer reported it.

deposit_id.description: The deposit this credit posts under. Set on every deposit entry, direct deposits included.

deposit_receipt_id.description: The landing this entry credits, on a direct deposit. One entry per landing.

asset.description: CAIP-19 id of the Balance's asset.

balance_id.description: The Balance the entry is on.

display_amount.description: The amount as a decimal string, for display only.

fiat.description: The fiat figure stamped with the entry: always on card spend, on a deposit when Final could value it. Absent otherwise.

related.description: The deposit or direct-deposit landing this entry credits. Absent on card entries.

status.description: Always posted. The ledger is append-only.

type.description: The entry type. deposit_credited is a deposit that Final credited. card_auth is card spend at authorization as a debit, or the credit that reverses it when the authorization is voided. More types will be added, so handle a value you do not recognise.

after_cursor.description: Send it as after_cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

asset.description: CAIP-19 id of the held asset. A sub-balance shares its root's.

available.description: What can be spent now, in the asset's smallest unit. Null on a sub-balance, which draws on its root. Can lag a deposit.credited event briefly.

card_id.description: The card on this Balance, or null. At most one.

display_available.description: The available amount as a decimal string, for display only.

display_pending.description: The pending amount as a decimal string, for display only.

label.description: The label given at creation. A root created by consent carries your integrator display name.

limits.description: Spending rules this Balance applies to itself.

parent_balance_id.description: The parent's id, or null on a root.

parent_imposed_limits.description: Rules an ancestor set on this Balance, which it cannot change itself.

pending.description: Deposits seen but not yet credited, in the asset's smallest unit. Null on a sub-balance.

status.description: Whether the Balance can still hold and spend.

balance_id.description: The Balance the card spends from.

embed_url.description: Open it top level in a web view. It renders the card number, expiry and CVC.

expires_at.description: When the URL expires. Mint a new one after it.

after_cursor.description: Send it as after_cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

activated_at.description: When it became active, or null.

balance_id.description: The Balance the card spends from.

closed_at.description: When it was closed, or null.

frozen_at.description: When it was frozen, or null.

last4.description: The last four digits. Null while provisioning.

network.description: The card network. Null while provisioning.

status.description: The card status. It is provisioning until the Balance's tree has a credited deposit.

amount.description: What the merchant charges, in the currency's smallest unit.

asset_amount.description: What the swipe pulls from the Balance, in the asset's smallest unit.

decline_reason.description: Declines only. The same reason card_auth.declined carries.

partner_auth_id.description: Carried on the card_auth.* events for this swipe.

code.description: From ?code= on the redirect. Valid for 10 minutes. Omitted only on the test-mode terminal flow.

code_verifier.description: The verifier whose hash you proposed with, 43 to 128 characters.

assets.description: CAIP-19 ids. One root Balance per asset.

grant.description: What the user approved. Null until they approve.

reference.description: Your own id for the user, from a secret-key proposal. Null otherwise.

client_secret.description: The secret for this connection, in the form connection_…_secret_…. With a publishable key, send it as the Final-Connection header on each request for this connection. Final returns it only once, so store it securely.

created_at.description: When the user approved. While pending or failed, when the proposal was made.

failure_reason.description: Why the approval did not complete. Set only when status is failed.

grant.description: What the user approved. Null while pending or failed.

livemode.description: Whether this is a live-mode connection.

reference.description: Your own id for the user, from a secret-key proposal. Null otherwise.

revoked_at.description: When this connection was revoked, or null. Also null on a connection that is revoked because the user revoked its grant.

status.description: The connection state: pending until the user approves, failed if the approval did not complete, then active until revoked. A secret key reads every state. With a publishable key and the connection's client_secret, a revoked connection answers 403 connection_revoked instead.

amount.description: What lands, in the Balance asset's smallest unit.
The most authoritative figure known, in the asset's smallest unit: settled, else detected, else the pinned outbound amount.

asset.description: CAIP-19 id of the asset credited.

balance_id.description: The root Balance the deposit credits.

credited_at.description: When the ledger entry was posted, or null.

display_amount.description: amount as a decimal string, for display only.

partner_detected_at.description: When Final detected the inbound transfer, or null.

received_via.description: The instruction the funds arrived through, when one was published.

deposit_id.description: The deposit the credit posts under.

display_fee_amount.description: The fee_amount as a decimal string, for display only.

display_gross_total.description: The gross_total as a decimal string, for display only.

display_net_amount.description: The net_amount as a decimal string, for display only.

fee_amount.description: Final's fee, taken from what landed.

gross_total.description: What landed, before the fee, in the asset's smallest unit.

address.description: The user's own wallet address, where landings arrive. Every Balance on the account shares it. To show a sender where to send, use the onchain_address instruction from deposit_instructions, which withholds the address while a step is outstanding.

after_cursor.description: Send it as after_cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

display_waiting_total.description: The waiting_total as a decimal string, for display only.

fee_basis_points.description: Final's fee on each landing, in basis points.

fiat_currency.description: The unit the fiat figures are in.

minimum_fiat.description: The floor a group must reach to credit, in fiat_currency's smallest unit.

waiting_total.description: What is waiting to credit, in the asset's smallest unit.

waiting_total_fiat.description: The same, in fiat_currency's smallest unit.

balance_id.description: Present only when the window is on your Balance.

closed_at.description: When it was closed early, when it was.

id.description: Present only when the window is on your Balance.

opened_by_caller.description: Whether your own connection opened it.

ends_at.description: An hour from now by default, or the latest allowed if that is sooner. The latest allowed is 24 hours out by default and can differ by environment. A time not in the future, or later than that, answers 400 ends_at_out_of_range.

replace_active.description: Close the open window and open this one in its place. Through a connection, only a window that connection opened; the account's own credentials close any window. Without it, an open window answers 409 override_in_flight.

amount.description: What landed, before the fee, in the asset's smallest unit.

balance_id.description: The Balance it routed to, or null while unrouted.

batch.description: Present once the fee pull has started.

block_time.description: When the chain recorded it, when known.

chain.description: CAIP-2 id of the chain it landed on.

display_amount.description: The amount as a decimal string, for display only.

livemode.description: Whether this is a live-mode landing.

waiting_reason.description: Why it has not credited. Absent when nothing is in the way.

address.description: The user's own wallet address, where landings arrive. Every Balance on the account shares it. To show a sender where to send, use the onchain_address instruction from deposit_instructions, which withholds the address while a step is outstanding.

default_balance_id.description: The account's default for this asset, or null when unset or not yours.

is_default.description: Whether this Balance is the default.

routed_by.description: The rule a landing arriving now would route by.

base.description: CAIP-19 id of the held asset.

display_rate.description: The rate, rounded for display only.

rate.description: Quote units per one base unit, as a decimal string. Compute against this.

detail.description: More about the failure, as an object whose shape depends on code. On a user-present gate it carries url, where to send the user.

param.description: The field at fault, when one is.

request_id.description: Always present. The X-Request-ID that you sent, or an id that Final generates if you sent none or an invalid one. Include this value in support requests.

assets.description: 1 to 8 CAIP-19 ids. One root Balance each.

code_challenge.description: The PKCE challenge: base64url(sha256(code_verifier)). Required on a publishable key.

direct_deposit.description: Ask to route the user's own deposits to your Balances.

redirect_uri.description: Must exactly equal a registered redirect. Omitting it falls back to the primary.

reference.description: Your own id for the user, up to 256 printable characters. Secret key only.

kind.description: The type of proposal. Currently always account.connect.

payload.description: The details of the proposal. Its shape depends on kind.

connection.description: The connection whose creation is proposed.

id.description: The connection id you will activate or address.

after_cursor.description: Send it as after_cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

approval_url.description: Open it top level as it is. Set only while status is pending_approval, null otherwise. It does not expire.

approved_at.description: When the user approved, or null.

connection.description: The connection created from this proposal. Present on the single read and on events, never on the list.

kind.description: The type of proposal. Currently always account.connect.

payload.description: The details of the proposal. Its shape depends on kind.

result_resource.description: The connection the approval created, once completed.

type.description: At most max per calendar period.
At most max to one recipient.

id.description: The merchant name as the issuer reports it.

kind.description: The recipient kind: merchant, for card spend.

type.description: At most max in any window of this length.

window.description: ISO 8601 duration, such as P1D or PT1H.

amount.description: The cap, in that asset's smallest unit.

asset.description: The cap's asset: iso4217:USD, or the Balance's own asset.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque secret; resolved by prefix to a session token or API key.
